Dayi left-side paging panel for physical keyboards

Designed for external physical keyboards: the \"▲ (page up) / ▼ (page down)\" paging controls are moved to the far left, so you can type with your right hand and page with your left. The buttons light up according to the available pages, greatly reducing hand movement fatigue and mistaps.

Drops the traditional XML title bar so the settings screen extends to the top edge, combined with a minimal left navigation bar and a frosted-glass gradient background, freeing up more than 15% of reading space for a refined look.
The Dayi smart selection module is upgraded to an \"AI smart core\" with a new breathing status light. When enabled it glows green and softly lights the whole card to show the engine state.

If the input method misbehaves or mapping tables are missing, reset the settings (on tablets, tap \"Reset settings\" at the bottom of the left navigation panel; on phones, use \"Reset to defaults\" in the top-right menu). This solves more than 95% of problems.
After installing new mapping tables, make sure the \"Enable Dayi\" and \"Enable Chuyin\" switches are on.
While typing, use your right hand on the physical keyboard to enter key codes and candidate number keys.
To page, tap \"▲ (previous page)\" and \"▼ (next page)\" at the far left edge of the tablet screen with your left hand.
Physical keyboards can commit words directly by default. You can also turn on \"Sort by selection on physical keyboard\" in Settings to keep frequently used words at the front.
If you still want the on-screen keyboard while a physical keyboard is connected, turn off \"Auto-hide on-screen keyboard\" in Settings.
Added an English interface that follows the system or app language; the 注音 input method is called Chuyin.
Importing mapping files now uses the system file picker, so you can pick files from anywhere; imports run in the background and no longer freeze the screen.
Added \"Import related phrases\"; learned related phrases are kept when importing.
The \"Auto-hide on-screen keyboard\" setting now works: turn it off to keep the on-screen keyboard while a physical keyboard is connected.
The share-text import dialog can be closed with Back and no longer pops up again after rotating the screen.
Stability fixes: a locked database no longer freezes input, and key labels that are too long shrink to fit.
Dayi candidates now list only exact code matches and support three-code input (1st, 2nd and last root), matching desktop Dayi; continuous typing also accepts three-code input.
Added light-mode colors for the candidate bar and panels.
Fixed stale candidates after fast deleting or typing, and Space picking a character from the previous code.
Smart selection only promotes exact code matches instead of characters from other codes.
English prediction fixes: tapping a suggestion no longer crashes, words after a space get predictions, the cursor lands after the picked word, and moving the cursor restarts prediction.
Space now picks the first candidate while composing in Chuyin and other input methods; phone-keypad auto-commit is more reliable.
Stability fixes: no more crashes when opening shared text, deleting a related phrase by long press or adding a memo, and root display no longer mixes up.
Learning and import now use safe database queries, so words with quotes are learned and imported correctly.
Removed swipe selection and unused themes.
New on-screen keyboard: white letter keys, light green function keys and rounded corners, with TalkBack reading each key; the emoji and memo panels use matching colors, and typing uses less power.
Learned data is now kept separately and restored after importing a dictionary; use \"Export my data\" and \"Import my data\" in Settings, or turn on \"Back up to Google account\".

Dayi continuous typing: 3 or more letters or digits in a row are no longer auto-committed, so English words and long numbers can be typed; for characters sharing a code with no selection history, the one that most often follows the previous character comes first; deleting all composing text ends continuous typing.

Chuyin: readings with many homophones now list every candidate; picking a character for the first syllable in continuous typing no longer drops the following syllables; Simplified and other non-Big5 characters move to the end of the same reading.
Added a voice input button to the candidate toolbar; \"Reverse lookup\" is now a setting, with results shown on the left of the candidate bar.

Fixes: switching fields after using a physical keyboard no longer hides and rebuilds the on-screen keyboard; switching light/dark mode while the keyboard is hidden no longer crashes; Delete removes text directly while English predictions are shown.
Removed old-device physical keyboard settings, the ineffective \"Reset\" option and Simplified/Traditional conversion; \"Shortcut reference\" now lists all physical keyboard punctuation.
Dayi left-side paging for external physical keyboards (▲/▼).
Upgraded the two-pane full-screen immersive settings console on tablets and hid the XML AppBarLayout.
Redesigned the Dayi smart selection AI card and added a green/grey breathing status light.
Moved Help and Reset to the bottom of the navigation bar.
Simplified the architecture by removing the old voice input key and VoiceInputActivity.
Added 66 passing unit test cases for LimeDB, IMSwitchHelper and OptionsDialogHelper.
Fixed the emoji keyboard (Emoji Picker) interrupting input and crashing the input method when switched to.
Improved input method startup stability and system integration.
Adopted Material Design 3 throughout, with dynamic color and edge-to-edge display.
Fixed random crashes caused by the side menu.
Changed the version format to a date (yyyy.MM.dd) for easier identification.
Tap the buttons at the top right to paste or add a memo
